caseNameFull: California v. Southland Royalty Co. El Paso Natural Gas Co. v. Southland Royalty Co. and Federal Power Commission v. Southland Royalty Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 433 U. S. 907.] Motions of Associated Gas Distributors and Public Service Commission of New York for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.

Mr. Justice Stewart and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
